name: blackboard-mcp
description: Ask Claude about your own Syracuse Blackboard: what's due, grades, announcements, course files, and the links your professors post.
long_description: Read-only. It signs in as you, in a browser window with a red banner where you type your NetID and Duo yourself, so it only sees what you can already see, and it can never submit, post, or change anything. Everything stays on your computer. Not affiliated with Syracuse University or Anthology/Blackboard.
